title: Segment Frames, Terminal Controls, and a Board Closure
purpose: Add three reader-friendly, bounded evidence objects to the public archive without disclosing active unsolved-output routes or claiming new plaintext.
selection_notes: E1477 is included only as a direct complete-board route-family closure with its missing-original-scorer limitation prominent.
E156 is restricted to the exact solved-LP1 segment-boundary observation and complete combinatorial control.
E159 contains only established Page 73 and Page 74 positive controls; unsolved-segment outputs and active route details are excluded.
The packages redistribute normalized ledgers and portable verifiers, not third-party corpus imagery, full transcriptions, or private typed event streams.
No object claims a newly recovered LP2 plaintext, key, locator, endpoint, wallet, or complete solve.
release_notes: Release candidate for RR-0003. Publication requires the exact-subject research gate to be approved before merge or tagging.
